idea-plugin.name: Marginalis
idea-plugin.description:
Review AI-written code where it lives. Marginalis lets you and your coding agent discuss code in comment threads anchored to the lines they are about, inside your JetBrains IDE.

Agents write code faster than anyone can review it in a chat window. Marginalis moves the review into the editor. The agent leaves findings, questions and walkthroughs next to the code, you answer in place, and a thread closes only when its outcome is in the code.

What you get

  • Feedback next to the code. Threads attach to a line, a selection, a file or the whole project, and stay attached through edits and restarts.
  • Clear turns. Badges on files and in the tool window show what waits on you. Submit your replies as one round while your agents keep listening, see who is listening or working at a glance, or switch a single thread to Live for a quick back and forth.
  • Reviews that sort themselves. The agent marks what blocks, what is a nit and what needs no answer, so you can focus on what matters first.
  • Pull request reviews in one place. Your agent brings a PR's review comments, from teammates and review bots, next to the code they are about, each one attributed to its author.
  • Guided walkthroughs. The agent takes you through a change step by step.
  • Decisions in one click. Agree with a proposal without typing, and follow links straight to the code under discussion.
  • Several agents, one margin. A designing agent and an implementing agent can share the same threads without getting in each other's way.

Getting started

Install the plugin, then give your agent the skill with one command. It works with Claude Code and more than 70 other agents:

npx skills add MuhammadFarag/marginalis -g -y

Any other agent can learn the full protocol from the running plugin at GET http://127.0.0.1:63342/api/marginalis/agent_guide.

Private by design

Your threads stay with your project on your machine. The plugin talks to your agent over the IDE's local server and never writes to GitHub. Open source under Apache-2.0.
